request: Write an advertorial presell page for our cooling pillow and the ads that lead into it. Our current presell is a 7-reasons listicle and it isn't converting well; tell me where readers drop.
note: Example data: an invented online pillow store with invented accounts, rivals and reviews, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.

brief.business: Loftline (invented example), an online store selling one cooling pillow in the US
brief.product: Loftline Cooling Pillow: a pillow with a phase-change fabric cover and removable shredded foam fill, so the sleeper can take fill out to make it lower
brief.offer_terms: 100-night return window with a full refund; Loftline pays return shipping
brief.voice: plain, warm, first person from the founder; no hype words
brief.limits: no medical or disease claims; no 'doctor recommended'; the legal reviewer signs off before launch

proof_list.claim: 4.6 average rating from 1,240 verified-buyer reviews on loftline.example
In an independent lab test (Example Textile Lab, invented, report ETL-2291, March 2026), the cover surface measured 2.1°C cooler than a cotton pillowcase after 30 minutes of contact
100-night return window with a full refund; Loftline pays return shipping
The cover is machine washable at 40°C, and the shredded foam fill can be removed to lower the pillow

Founder story: Maya Chen co-founded Loftline in 2023 after six years of waking up hot at night and flipping her pillow, whose cool side lasted about twenty minutes. Before that she tried a thin pillow (cooler, but a stiff neck), a gel pillow (cold for a few minutes, then warm), a fan at the bed and an open window in winter. The team tested covers for months before choosing the phase-change fabric. She approved this account
Customer story: Dana R. gave written permission to quote her review R07 with her first name and last initial; she was not paid or given product for it
